title: Auxiliary universe-transfer reduction for Brown representability
statement: Under the hypotheses of lem-pc-brown-representability-universe-transfer, the common-universe Brown principle yields an object G : C and a natural representing-by structure for the underlying set-valued functor H ⋙ forget AddCommGrpCat.

source.place: Tag 0A8F, with explicit universe transport supplied by the worker

proof.text: Let A = ULiftHom.{max w v vH} C and E = ULiftHom.equiv. Apply triangulatedEquivalenceTransfer to obtain proved zero, additive, shift and triangulated structures on A, with both directions triangulated. Install the returned instances and the induced inverse shift comparison.

Transfer coproducts using Adjunction.hasColimitsOfShape_of_equivalence E.inverse. Apply compactGenerationEquivalence E hC; the additive instances of the equivalence follow from its triangulated functors.

Set L = E.inverse.op ⋙ H and K = L ⋙ AddCommGrpCat.uliftFunctor. L is homological by triangulated precomposition. For each distinguished triangle, its exact image under L remains exact after the additive group lift by ShortComplex.Exact.map. Products are preserved by composition of the equivalence, H and the group lift. Apply the assumed hBrown to A, K and these proved hypotheses.

For the resulting G and additive natural isomorphism e : K ≅ preadditiveYoneda.obj G, represent H by G.objDown. The hom equivalence is Equiv.ulift.symm followed by the underlying equivalence of e.symm.app (op (ULiftHom.objUp X)), followed by Equiv.ulift. Evaluate naturality of e.inv at ULift.up g and apply ULift.down to obtain homEquiv_comp. Thus the representing-by structure is constructed explicitly, not chosen from another representability theorem.

lean.statement:
theorem brownCohomologicalRepresentabilityUniverseTransfer_aux
    (C : Type u) [Category.{v} C] [HasZeroObject C] [HasShift C ℤ]
    [Preadditive C] [∀ n : ℤ, (shiftFunctor C n).Additive] [Pretriangulated C]
    [IsTriangulated C] [HasCoproducts.{max w v vH} C]
    (hC : IsCompactlyGeneratedTriangulated.{max w v vH} C)
    (H : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{vH}) [H.IsHomological]
    (hH : ∀ I : Type (max w v vH), PreservesLimitsOfShape (Discrete I) H)
    (hBrown : ∀ (A : Type u) [Category.{max w v vH} A]
      [HasZeroObject A] [HasShift A ℤ] [Preadditive A]
      [∀ n : ℤ, (shiftFunctor A n).Additive] [Pretriangulated A]
      [IsTriangulated A] [HasCoproducts.{max w v vH} A],
      IsCompactlyGeneratedTriangulated.{max w v vH} A →
      ∀ (K : Aᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{max w v vH}) [K.IsHomological],
      (∀ I : Type (max w v vH), PreservesLimitsOfShape (Discrete I) K) →
      ∃ G : A, Nonempty (K ≅ preadditiveYoneda.obj G)) :
    ∃ G : C, Nonempty ((H ⋙ forget AddCommGrpCat).RepresentableBy G)
